metadata.method: For each company and quarter: add up the expenses on every in-house report (a company reporting its own lobbying), add up the income on every outside-firm report (a lobbying firm reporting what the company paid it), and use the larger of the two sums. In-house expenses normally already include payments to outside firms, so adding both would double count.
notes: Amounts are as reported; filers round to the nearest $10,000 and may leave amounts under $5,000 blank.
Latest posted version of each report in the saved snapshot; later amendments can change past quarters.
Dollars cover a whole report and are not assigned to issues.
Company grouping follows data/reference/companies/lda_clients.csv: subsidiaries roll up to the parent; subcontractor reports are excluded.
